description: V - Solarpark_Obere_Wiesen / V_B_V_2026 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by apps.villingen-schwenningen.de. Urban development plan of the city of Villingen-Schwenningen. Use: So solar park traffic area. The development plan contains the legally binding stipulations for the urban development order. In principle, the development plan must be developed from the land use plan. Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Bebauungsplan, Bauleitplanung, Bebauung, Villingen-Schwenningen, Bodennutzung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://geoh.conterra:8080/oai-pmh-geo-harvest/harvesters/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
